style: Clean flat vector illustration for a beginner guitar manual, thin dark navy outlines, a few flat fills (warm brass, off-white, navy), no text, no labels, no numbers, plain white background, generous margins, subject filling most of the frame.

parts.prompt: A single acoustic dreadnought guitar seen strictly from the front, perfectly vertical and symmetrical, centered, filling the frame from top to bottom. Every part clearly separated and readable: headstock with three tuning machines on each side, nut, frets along the neck, the body with its waist, the round soundhole, the bridge, six strings running from the tuners to the bridge. No hands, no background scene, no shadow.
mustShow: six tuning machines on the headstock

sit.prompt: A person sitting on the front edge of a chair with a backrest, not leaning on it, playing an acoustic guitar: back straight, both feet flat on the floor, guitar body resting on the right thigh, guitar upright against the chest, neck rising clearly to the left so the headstock is at shoulder height, right forearm resting on the edge of the guitar body. Three-quarter front view, whole body in frame.
mustShow: a chair with a backrest, person on its front edge
both feet flat on the floor
headstock at shoulder height, neck tilted up
right forearm on the edge of the body

left.prompt: Close-up of a left hand fretting a chord on an acoustic guitar neck, seen from the front of the guitar with the neck tilted up to the left as a player holds it: the thumb visible behind the neck, resting roughly opposite the middle finger, the four fingers arched like holding a ball, only the fingertips pressing the strings just behind the metal frets, knuckles up and away from the strings, wrist straight and relaxed. The hand must not wrap around the neck.
mustShow: thumb behind the neck, visible above the edge
fingers arched, fingertips on the strings
knuckles away from the strings, no fist grip

pick.prompt: Close-up of a right hand holding a guitar pick over the soundhole of an acoustic guitar: the pick pinched between the pad of the thumb and the side of the curled index finger, with only two or three millimetres of the pick tip showing below the fingers, the other fingers relaxed and slightly curled. The pick is mostly hidden by the fingers.
mustShow: pick between thumb pad and side of the index finger
only the tip of the pick visible, a few millimetres
